definitions: Every difficult or unpleasant situation has some positive aspect or potential for good.
There is always something good to be found even in bad situations.
examples: I lost my job, but every cloud has a silver lining; now I have time to pursue my passion.
The car broke down, but every cloud has a silver lining, we discovered a lovely village while waiting for repairs.
It rained all week on our holiday, but every cloud has a silver lining, we spent quality time indoors playing games.
lemma: every cloud has a silver lining
source: every cloud has a silver lining
